title.zh: Index TTS 声音克隆 (indextts-2) 接口上线

summary.en: Dedicated voice clone and emotional TTS model `indextts-2` is now available on OmniMux via POST /v1/tasks/autodl.
summary.zh: 声音克隆与情绪语音合成模型 `indextts-2` 现已接入 OmniMux，支持通过 POST /v1/tasks/autodl 端点进行异步调用。

body.en:
## Index TTS 2

The `indextts-2` voice clone model is now supported on OmniMux.

### Model specification

- **Model ID:** `indextts-2`
- **Create endpoint:** `POST /v1/tasks/autodl`
- **Polling endpoint:** `GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}`
- **Artifact endpoint:** `GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}/artifacts`
- **Authentication:** Bearer token (`sk-...`)

### Request example

```json
{
  "model": "indextts-2",
  "prompt_text": "Hello, this is a cloned voice generation test.",
  "prompt_simple": "https://example.com/reference_audio.wav",
  "emo_control_method": "same_as_reference"
}
```

Full parameter specifications are documented in the [Index TTS Reference](/en/api-reference/audio-series/models/index-tts).
body.zh:
## Index TTS 2

声音克隆模型 `indextts-2` 现已接入 OmniMux 提供异步调用。

### 接口规范

- **模型标识：** `indextts-2`
- **任务提交端点：** `POST /v1/tasks/autodl`
- **任务状态查询：** `GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}`
- **生成产物获取：** `GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}/artifacts`
- **鉴权方式：** Bearer 令牌鉴权（`sk-...`）

### 请求示例

```json
{
  "model": "indextts-2",
  "prompt_text": "你好，这是一段声音克隆合成测试台词。",
  "prompt_simple": "https://example.com/reference_audio.wav",
  "emo_control_method": "与音色参考音频相同"
}
```

完整参数定义与情绪调节字段详见 [Index TTS 接口参考文档](/zh/api-reference/audio-series/models/index-tts)。
